$comment: Neutral shipped <stddef.h> (C89 7.17) — the common typedefs + NULL, as language-NEUTRAL data injected by the semantic phase (see README + limits.json). `size_t`/`ptrdiff_t` are pointer-width = 8 bytes on EVERY current DSS target (all 64-bit; LP64 + LLP64 agree on pointer width) -> u64/i64; an ILP32 target would make them 4-byte (deferred D-FFI-STDINT-PTR-WIDTH-ILP32, shared with stdint). `wchar_t` is `{ "abiTypedef": "wchar_t" }` (P68 round 9, D-C-WCHAR-T-IS-SIGNED-ON-ARM64-LINUX): it is realized from the TARGET's `abiTypedefs` table for the build pair — the ONE source the type of `L'…'`/`L"…"` and `__SIZEOF_WCHAR_T__` read too — because the fact is per processor × platform, not per format: `int` on x86_64 Linux and on Darwin, `unsigned int` on aarch64 Linux, `unsigned short` on Windows (✔MEASURED 2026-09-23 by `_Generic` on a `wchar_t` object and on `L'a'`, gcc 13.3.0 + clang 18.1.3 on both Linux arches, mingw-w64 13.2.0 + MSVC 14.51; Darwin by lane `fo`'s round-8 `__WCHAR_TYPE__` measurement). The row used to be per-FORMAT variants (c106, D-FFI-STDDEF-WCHAR-PE-WIDTH: elf/macho i32, pe u16), which gave aarch64 Linux a SIGNED `wchar_t` where its platform's is unsigned — `(wchar_t)-1 > 0` was false. A pair whose target declares no `wchar_t` injects none, so a use fails loud rather than binding a guessed type. <stdlib.h> declares it the same way on every format (C23 7.24p3 lists it), and the pe-gated duplicates in stdio/io.json (the MSVC corecrt model: every CRT header defines wchar_t) read the same row. `NULL` is `((void*)0)`, a `macros` row (P68 round 9, found in passing under D-C-LIMITS-H-DEFINES-NINE-OF-THE-STANDARD-MACROS): C23 7.21p4 lets it be any implementation-defined null pointer constant, and every reference spells it `((void*)0)` in C — ✔MEASURED 2026-09-23, `_Generic(NULL, void *: 1, default: 0)` is 1 and `sizeof(NULL)` is 8 under gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 (x86_64 and aarch64 Linux), mingw-w64 13.2.0 and MSVC 14.51. It used to be the integer constant 0 on the `constants` surface, so `NULL` was an `int` (sizeof 4) under DSS: no measured miscompile (a 12-pointer varargs sentinel probe counted right on pe, x86_64 and aarch64, debug and release), but a different type from every reference in `_Generic`, `sizeof` and a variadic call. `offsetof` is a function-like macro onto the `__builtin_offsetof` intrinsic (P68 round 12 — D-FFI-OFFSETOF-MACRO had shipped only the intrinsic; see `$offsetofComment`). * D-LANG-TYPE-IDENTITY-VOCABULARY: the 64-bit aliases are no longer a bare `u64`/`i64`. C defines each as an ALIAS of a standard NAMED type, and WHICH name is DATA-MODEL-dependent - `uint64_t`/`uintptr_t`/`uintmax_t`/`size_t` ARE `unsigned long` on LP64 and `unsigned long long` on LLP64 (glibc vs mingw/MSVC spell them exactly so); `int64_t`/`intmax_t`/`ptrdiff_t` likewise `long` / `long long`. A bare core mints the ANONYMOUS representative, which since type identity was split off representation is a THIRD type matching NEITHER named entry: `stdc_count_ones((uint64_t)x)` fell out of <stdbit.h>'s 5-way `_Generic`, and `unsigned long long *p = &u64var;` became a bare S_TypeMismatch. Each therefore carries a variant selector plus the hir-text vocabulary tag - the SAME 8-byte core everywhere, a different IDENTITY. ** D-FFI-DESCRIPTOR-TYPE-ALIAS-SPELLING-KEYED-ON-DATA-MODEL-ALONE (P48 lane st, 2026-09-01): the selector USED TO BE `when:{dataModel}` ALONE, and the sentence above it is a TWO-WORLD assumption with a THIRD world under it - Darwin is LP64 yet spells `uint64_t` `unsigned long long` while keeping `size_t` `unsigned long`, so the aliases that key held together SPLIT. Every arm now names BOTH axes, `when:{dataModel,format}`; the full per-type per-platform measurement is recorded ONCE in `stdint.json`'s `$comment` and the arms here carry its answers for THIS header's aliases. MEASURED for both of them: `size_t` is `unsigned long` on elf AND macho and `unsigned long long` on pe; `ptrdiff_t` is `long` on elf AND macho and `long long` on pe - so neither VALUE moved, only the KEY that selects it. `dataModel` stays in the conjunction so a future ILP32 target matches 0 arms and fails LOUD (D-FFI-STDINT-PTR-WIDTH-ILP32, still open) instead of silently binding an 8-byte `unsigned long` where the platform's is 4.
$offsetofComment: ★ P68 round 12 (D-FFI-OFFSETOF-MACRO, CORRECTED, lane `lm`): C 7.21's `offsetof` — the MACRO, onto the `__builtin_offsetof` intrinsic that row shipped in P31. The intrinsic was all that closure delivered, and it named the macro only by reading gcc's and clang's own <stddef.h> through -E; DSS ships THIS <stddef.h>, where the macro never existed, so `#include <stddef.h>` + `offsetof(T, m)` was S_UndeclaredIdentifier (a typedef name) or a parse error (`struct S`) on all five pairs, debug and release (✔MEASURED 2026-09-24). The expansion is the one gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 (glibc) and mingw-w64 13.2.0 produce (✔MEASURED through -E) and the UCRT 10.0.26100.0 <stddef.h> selects under `_CRT_USE_BUILTIN_OFFSETOF`; its default MSVC C spelling `((size_t)&(((s*)0)->m))` has the same meaning and type. The intrinsic answers size_t (_Generic) as an integer constant expression (it sizes a static array) — ✔MEASURED on pe64, ELF x86_64 and ELF aarch64 (exit 42), both Mach-O arches build.
$c23Comment: ★ P68 round 12, fold S1b (D-C-STDDEF-H-LACKS-UNREACHABLE, lane `lm`): C23's `unreachable()`, `(__builtin_unreachable())` on every pair — gcc's own <stddef.h> spelling (gcc 13.3.0 x86_64 and the aarch64 cross, `-std=c2x`; glibc ships no <stddef.h>), where clang 18.1.3's `__stddef_unreachable.h` and Apple clang 21 spell the same void call unparenthesized (✔MEASURED 2026-09-24 through -E; MSVC 19.51 and mingw-w64 13.2.0 `-std=c2x` declare none in C) — over the GNU builtin gcc and clang accept, which DSS lacked too (S_UndeclaredIdentifier). The builtin ENDS its block with MIR's Unreachable terminator (a trap at the target: `ud2` / `brk #0`), never a fall-through. Still missing from C23 7.21 here: `max_align_t` (its representation is the pair's LONG-DOUBLE FORMAT — owed to S2 of [[D-C-STDLIB-H-LACKS-THIRTY-FIVE-ISO-NAMES]] as [[D-C-STDDEF-H-LACKS-MAX-ALIGN-T]]), `nullptr_t` ([[D-CSUBSET-NULLPTR-T-DECLARABLE]]) and so `__STDC_VERSION_STDDEF_H__`.
